implementationContract.algorithm: Transform enclosures into body frame; erode true convex tapered aperture by radius plus explicit numeric margin; test retained shell and authored cabin obstacle bounds separately; hinge moving panel geometry about actualpivot. Bound full angle interval with analytic trig extrema or proven conservative envelope, not endpoint-only samples. Broadphase bounds may overreject, never omit floor/seat/dashboard/steering or door interiors. Return unknown when source/detail/pose cannot be enclosed.
implementationContract.numerics: Keep analytical vertices distinct from Float32 mesh limits. Establish test-backed conservative outward obstacle/inward opening margin accounting for Float32 rounding and rigid transforms; contact within margin is blocked/unknown. Never move geometry to make clearance pass. Require a positive bounded margin and a documented lower numerical bound; reject insufficient margin.
implementationContract.pose: Static body yaw/pitch/roll/translation supported only through validated rigid transform. poseVehicle bounce causes body y/pitch/roll changes; moving/nondefault unspecified body poses must be unknown. Do not silently use car-root planar coordinates.
implementationContract.authority: Even candidate-clear output means only supplied-enclosure versus conservative geometry check. No actor fit, support, fullclip or travel authorization. Keep both authority flags false for every result.
